name: @hdsp/kiosk-desktop
description: ZoeConnect Kiosk Desktop -- a dedicated Electron shell for the existing Token Kiosk web app (frontend/src/app/token/print-kiosk and /kiosk/[slug]). This package does NOT reimplement the kiosk UI: it loads the existing kiosk pages, served by the already-installed ZoeConnect backend/frontend, inside a locked-down fullscreen Chromium window and replaces window.print() (browser print-preview) with Electron's silent, dialog-free webContents.print(). Built and packaged completely independently of installer/ZoeConnect.iss -- the main ZoeConnect installer is never touched by this package. See README.md for architecture and DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md for the hospital rollout flow.
author: ZoeConnect (ZoeConnect, Powered by LifeHIS)

scripts.dev: npm run build && cross-env KIOSK_DEV=1 electron .
